svg.title: Idolsmasher cohort emblem sprite
svg.desc: Sixteen struck-bronze sounding-point symbols for Twilight of the Idols chapters 5 to 8: four opener emblems, four end seals, five phase discs, three margin sigils.

symbol.title: Six errors collapsing into the noon disc
Shears beneath the uncut flame of passion
The idol of causality split into four errors
The pious mask over the lying tablets
Error one phase disc: quarter bronze
Error two phase disc: half bronze
Error three phase disc: three-quarter bronze
Error four phase disc: full bronze with forge pip
